d: Short, curly, orange-copper hair peeks from under a black top hat with a white plume and gold pins. The face is a white porcelain mask with a wide, black, grinning smile and narrow, slanted black eyes, conveying a mature but enigmatic age. The build is slender and lithe, dressed in a white long-sleeved blouse with a voluminous pleated ruff collar, a black corset, and a high-low black skirt featuring gold and black striped puffed bloomers underneath. Signature details include a single long-stemmed blue rose held in the hand and black pointed heeled boots with gold buckles.
